\newcommand{\backcover}{%

\begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture,overlay,shift={(current page.south west)}]

\node[anchor=north west,text width=16.4cm,text=white,align=justify,font=\coverfont\fontsize{11}{15.5}\selectfont] at (2.3,25.5) {%
This book builds the mathematical foundations of statistical inference step by step, starting from the axioms of probability. Every result is given with its proof; every chapter is completed by Python applications that check the theorems numerically and build intuition. It is written for undergraduate and graduate students of statistics or mathematics, and for researchers who want to understand why statistical methods work.\par\medskip
23 chapters, ranging from probability spaces to the central limit theorem, from the Cramér--Rao bound to the Neyman--Pearson lemma, from maximum likelihood theory to the bootstrap and Bayesian inference, from Stein's paradox to empirical Bayes, and from sequential tests to U-statistics and the EM algorithm.};
\node[anchor=north west,text width=11cm,text=white,font=\coverfont\fontsize{10.5}{14.5}\selectfont] at (2.3,18.6) {%
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.1em,itemsep=2pt,label={\color{covergold}\textbullet}]
  \item A complete theory with definitions, theorems and proofs
  \item 79 Python programs; every output was produced by running the code
  \item A Colab notebook for every chapter, one click away
  \item Real data: horse kicks, a sleeping drug, law schools, the Efron--Morris baseball data, Challenger
  \item Solved exercises and a detailed index
  \item A Turkish edition with the same content: \emph{İstatistik Teorisi}
\end{itemize}};
